what: Two year over year pairs that have no printable percentage, for different reasons.
notRecorded: Hand built. Not a recorded API response.

growthBeyondRange.expected: A rise of two hundred percent. The share unit kind on this page is a proportion between nought and one hundred percent, so no percentage is printed. Both years and the signed difference in dollars are. This is not a contrived case: the recorded fiscal year series for the most searched company in the dataset rises 104.4 percent into FY2025.

negativePriorYear.expected: The year before is negative, because more money was released back than was committed. A percentage measured against a negative base has no useful meaning, so none is printed.

emptySet.expected: No fiscal years came back at all. The spine reports available false with its own sentence and plots nothing. It does not plot a flat line at zero.
